localizedValues.name: Camp Host Site
localizedValues.description: This campsite is set aside for the Campground Host.
NOTE: Maximum RV/Trailer size is 30 feet.

localizedValues.name: HB1
localizedValues.description: This first come first served site is designated as a walk-in, bicycle-in site and is only for campers who arrive at the park on foot or bicycle. Campers with vehicles are not allowed to occupy site.

This site is ADA only. Only people with disabilities may reserve ADA sites. Proof of eligibility must be provided to park staff when you check in at the park.
NOTE: Maximum RV/Trailer size is 25 feet.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
G1 group camp includes three fire pits, picnic tables, potable water spigot, and a vault toilet restroom. Parking is located a short distance from the group camp. Campers can unload and load but must park in the designated parking area. The site is a square grassy area with tree and brush borders; the Touchet River is nearby. G1 is tent camping only; no exceptions. NO RVs, campers, trailers, or other wheel-based camping units are allowed. No hookups available.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: G2
localizedValues.description:
G2 group camp includes two fire pits, picnic tables, potable water spigot, and is near the main campground bathroom. The site is a rectangular grassy area with tree and brush borders. G2 accommodates smaller RVs, campers, trailers, and other wheel-based camping units as well as tents. No hookups available. Vehicles may park in the camp area. The road in and out is one way.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: TP1
localizedValues.description:
Pet Friendly. Per night pet fee applies, declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation. Read and understand pet rules. The teepee is 16 feet in diameter with trex decking flooring. No cooking or flames allowed inside the teepee. A designated parking spot is located at the teepee site. The Teepee sleeps 8 people, and the site includes a picnic table and a fire pit with grill top. Guests must bring their own items for sleeping inside the tipis. No mats, cots, air mattresses, or sleeping linens are provided.
A nearby 20-foot pad for RVs/Trailers is available for an additional fee at the park. There are no hook-ups with that pad.
